rationale: FWONK gapped up ~6.9% on no news catalyst while the broader market is down sharply (SPY -4.02%, VIXY +26.59%), suggesting an idiosyncratic move that is now fading — price is at only 9.5% of today's range, well below VWAP ($106.29) and the 9-EMA ($105.64), with the last five candles showing a clear downward drift toward the session low ($104.61).
